verdict.rationale: OpenAI's docs clearly describe streaming responses (start printing while generation continues) as a first-class API feature, and rate-limit/caching docs touch on latency-adjacent behavior, but there is no documented benchmark or guarantee of sub-second full-answer latency, and no independent measurement of streaming/latency behavior in the evidence pack. missing for 10: explicit sub-second latency benchmarks/SLAs, independent hands-on confirmation of streaming latency, quantified time-to-first-token data.
